name: Dragon Clan (Samurai Clan)
body:
The Way of the Dragon teaches that the world is a better place with the contrast of arcane magic and technology. Like yin and yang, students of this clan strike a balance that, when mastered, can be a strong and unexpected force.

Weapon Bond (Su)

At 5th level, a dragon clan samurai’s bond is shared between each of the weapons in their daisho. They can spend 1 ki point to invest power in either for up to 1 minute, or 3 ki points total to invest power in each. When power is invested in only one of their weapons, the samurai can shift it to the other as a move action for the duration.

This otherwise functions as the magus’s arcane pool class feature.

Grace of the Clouds (Su)

At 10th level, a dragon clan samurai within arm’s reach of a wall can use it to slow his descent by expending 1 point from his ki pool. When they use this ability, they take no damage from the fall (as if using feather fall), but they must be adjacent to a wall for the length of the fall (although this can be used to reduce the damage from a fall if only part of it is adjacent to a wall).

In addition, the samurai can spend 1 point from his ki pool as a move action to grant himself a fly speed (with perfect maneuverability) equal to his base land speed. They must end their movement each round on solid ground (or some other surface that can support his weight) or fall as normal. Once activated, this use of grace of the clouds lasts for 1 minute.

Way of the Dragon (Su)

At 14th level, a clan samurai can use a special one-hour ritual that allows them to become a true dragon of a specific type for a short time. This counts as casting contingency and form of the dragon II, except as noted here. See the form of the dragon spell for a list of which dragons the clan samurai can choose. Once the choice is made, it cannot be changed later. The samurai uses their daisho as the focus for the casting of the spells and requires no other components. The contingency lasts for as long as the samurai wishes to maintain the effect. Form of the dragon’s duration doesn’t begin until it is activated the first time. After performing the ritual, when the samurai is ready to change their form, they do so with a command word or phrase spoken on their turn.

Fury of the Clouds (Su)

Beginning at 16th level, the clan samurai gains a fly speed (with average maneuverability) equal to their base land speed.

When they have at least 1 ki point remaining in their ki pool, the samurai’s daisho deals +1d6 damage of the type shared by their chosen dragon.

Greater Dragon

At 18th level, when the clan samurai practices way of the dragon, they can produce the effects of contingency and form of the dragon III instead.
